defaults.backend: complete: clean-room project wiki collaboration extending the existing ProjectPage model — monotonic version history with restore, local view analytics, publish/local URL with unique slugs, deterministic md/html/txt exports with sha256 hashes, workspace-scoped labels, cycle-safe nested pages, ordered collections, typed editor blocks, and polling-based co-editing with block-scoped inline comments
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated wiki-pages Operations route lists all project pages and renders eight panels for version history, analytics, publication/export, labels, hierarchy, collections, editor blocks and inline comments; all controls wired with confirm-gated restore and static guard in test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: twelve additive workspace-scoped tables created by migration e0f2a3b4c5d6 (wiki_page_revisions, wiki_page_views, wiki_page_publications, wiki_page_exports, wiki_page_labels, wiki_page_label_links, wiki_page_nodes, wiki_page_collections, wiki_page_collection_items, wiki_page_blocks, wiki_page_comments, wiki_edit_sessions); no existing table altered
defaults.api: complete: one stable wiki-pages API group (version 1, no legacy claim, external_calls=false, external_delivery=false, realtime_transport=polling-only) covering all eight features with validation and 404/409/422 failure modes
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(TASK_READ) for reads and require(TASK_WRITE) for all writes; cross-workspace page, block, revision, collection and comment ids fail closed with 404; every mutation publishes an audited event
defaults.integration: complete: publishes wiki.page_changed, wiki.page_viewed, wiki.page_published, wiki.page_exported and wiki.page_commented to NOVARA's shared event spine; no Django, Channels/WebSocket, React editor package, hosted service or outbound network is contacted or copied
defaults.criteria: Eleven named acceptance tests plus a UI guard prove each PL row's behaviour end to end against real persisted rows: version restore appends without data loss, analytics are local-only, publication and exports are deterministic local renders, labels/collections/hierarchy validate, editor blocks and inline comments work, and workspaces are isolated.
defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. Django/Channels realtime transport, hosted public pages, PDF/DOCX export and third-party editor packages remain out of scope and are not claimed.
